description: All educational content: 8 subjects with full lesson content and quiz questions stored as TypeScript files using the interfaces defined in FEAT-001. Independent from FEAT-002 pages (content files are imported by pages, not the other way around). Must be authored before FEAT-004 gamification (which references subject IDs) and before final build.
steps: 1. Create src/content/subjects/mathematics.ts: export const mathematicsSubject: Subject with id='mathematics', name='Mathematics', icon='Calculator', color='text-primary', bgColor='bg-primary/10', and lessons array with 5 Lesson objects: (a) lesson id='math-001' title 'Addition Adventures' difficulty='beginner' duration=15 — content: 3 LessonContent text steps explaining addition with examples (carrying, word problems), 10 Question objects (types: multiple-choice, fill-in-blank, true-false) covering single digit, double digit, and word problems; (b) lesson 'math-002' 'Multiplication Magic' difficulty='beginner' duration=20 — times tables 1-10, 10 questions; (c) lesson 'math-003' 'Fantastic Fractions' difficulty='intermediate' duration=20 — halves, thirds, quarters, comparing fractions, 10 questions; (d) lesson 'math-004' 'Geometry World' difficulty='intermediate' duration=25 — shapes (circle, square, triangle, rectangle, pentagon, hexagon), perimeter basics, 10 questions; (e) lesson 'math-005' 'Number Patterns' difficulty='intermediate' duration=20 — sequences, skip counting, odd/even, 10 questions. All questions have English and French translations. Each question has 10 points.

2. Create src/content/subjects/science.ts: export const scienceSubject: Subject with id='science', icon='FlaskConical', color='text-blue', bgColor='bg-blue/10'. 5 lessons: (a) 'sci-001' 'Our Solar System' — 8 planets, the Sun, moons, distance facts, 10 questions including ordering planets by distance, planet characteristics; (b) 'sci-002' 'The Human Body' — major organs (heart, lungs, brain, stomach, skeleton), their functions, 10 questions; (c) 'sci-003' 'Amazing Animals' — mammal/reptile/bird/fish/amphibian classification, habitats, African animals (elephant, lion, gorilla, okapi — note okapi is native to DRC), 10 questions; (d) 'sci-004' 'Plants and Nature' — photosynthesis simplified, plant parts (roots, stem, leaves, flowers, seeds), tropical rainforest (Congo Basin reference), 10 questions; (e) 'sci-005' 'Weather and Climate' — weather types (sun, rain, thunder, snow), seasons, climate zones in Africa, DRC's equatorial climate, 10 questions. All bilingual.

3. Create src/content/subjects/geography.ts: export const geographySubject: Subject with id='geography', icon='Globe', color='text-turquoise', bgColor='bg-turquoise/10'. 5 lessons: (a) 'geo-001' 'The 7 Continents' — names, sizes, notable features, 10 questions (multiple-choice + matching pairs); (b) 'geo-002' 'African Countries' — 10 featured countries including DRC (capital Kinshasa, largest country in sub-Saharan Africa), Nigeria, South Africa, Kenya, Ethiopia, Egypt, Ghana, Tanzania, Senegal, Morocco — capitals, flags descriptions, 10 questions; (c) 'geo-003' 'World Capitals' — 10 capital cities quiz (Paris/France, London/UK, Washington DC/USA, Beijing/China, Nairobi/Kenya, Kinshasa/DRC, Cairo/Egypt, Brasília/Brazil, Tokyo/Japan, Canberra/Australia), 10 questions; (d) 'geo-004' 'Oceans and Seas' — 5 oceans (Pacific, Atlantic, Indian, Arctic, Southern), Congo River (longest river in DRC), Great Lakes of Africa, 10 questions; (e) 'geo-005' 'Flags of the World' — 10 flags by color/symbol description (no image files needed — describe in text: 'The flag of Kenya has three horizontal stripes: black, red and green, with a Maasai shield in the center'), 10 questions. Strong DRC/Africa content throughout.

4. Create src/content/subjects/history.ts: export const historySubject: Subject with id='history', icon='Landmark', color='text-coral', bgColor='bg-coral/10'. 3 lessons: (a) 'hist-001' 'Ancient Egypt' — pharaohs, pyramids, hieroglyphics, the Nile, Sphinx, 8 questions; (b) 'hist-002' 'African History and Heritage' — Great Zimbabwe, Mali Empire (Mansa Musa), Kingdom of Kongo (direct ancestor of DRC), Sundiata Keïta, African independence movements, Patrice Lumumba (DRC first Prime Minister — age-appropriate context), 8 questions; (c) 'hist-003' 'Great Inventions' — printing press, lightbulb (Edison), telephone (Bell), internet, writing, wheel, medicine — age-appropriate inventors and dates, 8 questions. All bilingual.

5. Create src/content/subjects/languages.ts: export const languagesSubject: Subject with id='languages', icon='BookOpen', color='text-yellow', bgColor='bg-yellow/10'. 3 lessons: (a) 'lang-001' 'English Vocabulary Builder' — 20 themed vocabulary words (school, animals, colors, numbers, family) with definitions, usage in sentences, 8 questions including fill-in-blank and multiple-choice; (b) 'lang-002' 'Grammar Basics' — nouns, verbs, adjectives, simple sentence structure, subject-verb agreement, 8 questions; (c) 'lang-003' 'Reading Comprehension' — a short 3-paragraph story (100 words) about a child in Kinshasa discovering a library, 8 comprehension questions. All questions have EN and FR variants.

6. Create src/content/subjects/general-knowledge.ts: export const generalKnowledgeSubject: Subject with id='general-knowledge', icon='Lightbulb', color='text-pink', bgColor='bg-pink/10'. 1 lesson: 'gen-001' 'World Knowledge Challenge' — 20 mixed questions covering: animals (what is the largest animal on land? — elephant), science (what do plants need to grow? — sun, water, soil), geography (how many continents are there? — 7), history (where were the pyramids built? — Egypt), language (what language do people in France speak? — French), nature, DRC facts (what is the capital of DRC? — Kinshasa; what river runs through DRC? — Congo River). Mix of multiple-choice and true-false.

7. Create src/content/subjects/logic.ts: export const logicSubject: Subject with id='logic', icon='Brain', color='text-mint', bgColor='bg-mint/10'. 2 lessons/challenges: (a) 'log-001' 'Pattern Power' — visual/numeric pattern sequences described in text (1, 3, 5, 7, _?; red, blue, red, blue, _?), 10 questions of fill-in-blank and multiple-choice; (b) 'log-002' 'Logic Puzzles' — simple if-then logic, sorting, comparing (heavier/lighter, bigger/smaller), 10 questions. Age-appropriate for 6-12.

8. Create src/content/subjects/programming.ts: export const programmingSubject: Subject with id='programming', icon='Code', color='text-blue', bgColor='bg-blue/10'. 2 lessons: (a) 'prog-001' 'What is a Computer?' — hardware (screen, keyboard, mouse, CPU), software, what computers can do, internet basics, 10 questions; (b) 'prog-002' 'Introduction to Algorithms' — what is an algorithm (step-by-step instructions), everyday algorithm examples (recipe, morning routine), simple flowchart concepts in text, 10 questions including ordering-steps type (use matching-pairs question type).

9. Create src/content/subjects/index.ts: export const allSubjects: Subject[] = [mathematicsSubject, scienceSubject, geographySubject, historySubject, languagesSubject, generalKnowledgeSubject, logicSubject, programmingSubject]. Also export helper functions: getSubjectById(id: string): Subject | undefined; getAllLessons(): Lesson[]; getLessonById(lessonId: string): Lesson | undefined; getLessonsBySubject(subjectId: string): Lesson[]; getQuestionsByLesson(lessonId: string): Question[].

10. Create src/content/challenges/daily-challenges.ts: export const dailyChallenges: DailyChallenge[] = array of 14 challenges (2 weeks rotation). Each challenge picks 5 questions from an existing lesson. Include challenges from each subject: 2 math, 2 science, 2 geography, 1 history, 1 language, 1 general knowledge, 2 logic, 1 programming, 2 alternating. Each challenge: id='challenge-YYYYMMDD-{n}', bonusPoints=100, title in EN+FR. Also export getDailyChallenge(dateString: string): DailyChallenge — uses getDailyChallengeIndex() from date utils to pick from the array.

No question uses emojis in its text
